description: This file defines the ColumnDataLabelRenderer class, a specialized renderer for data labels in column charts within the PDFsharp charting library. It handles formatting, positioning, and drawing of data labels for column series.

classes.name: ColumnDataLabelRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for rendering data labels on column charts within the PDFsharp charting library.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space needed for each data label, setting their text and size based on the data and formatting rules.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the prepared data labels onto the graphics context, aligning them within or outside the columns as specified.

methods.name: CalcPositions
methods.description: Calculates the positions of each data label relative to its column, based on the specified label position (inside, outside, centered).
